staticArt.label: final-art
staticArt.verdict: Pass for isolated visual review. Rounded resting contours remove the angular side corners seen in iteration10. Outer finger-to-palm joins are connected, wrists continue into frame, compact palm remains visible, and active/ready finger badges remain clear.
staticArt.limitations: Static isolated contact sheets verify these seven fixture families and do not replace the packaged motion/performance checks owned by root.

checks: Seven fixed poses: both hands, exact white/black key contact, stable 88 key nodes and two non-intercepting canvases
Number view at laptop/large sizes and reduced-motion held-note pose remain available
User's exact mixed-reach thumb/ring fingering targets preserved in all six companion room palettes
Pointer through thumb and computer key D can share E4 with simulated MIDI; releasing either owner preserves the other hold
Repeated C4 lifts and strikes again; held C3 stays under the same finger while other notes change
The hands glide before their leap and land on C6 while all 88 keyboard hit targets and both canvases stay stable
Pause freezes the hands; seeking directly to another bar shows that position without an animated sweep
A pointer can press and release the key directly beneath the rendered hand
Changing reduced motion during a glide stops anticipation immediately, keeps a steady hand position, and preserves wrong-note feedback
Both views retain the existing frame-time budget on a 9,600-note score; raw rAF timing, slow frames and device density are recorded

ui.title: Appassionata · III. Allegro ma non troppo — Presto
ui.visualInspection: Native screenshot after fitting the window shows the complete keyboard and compact curved hand illustrations at bar 378.
ui.windowFit: Native zoom action fits the previously partly offscreen window; no application setting changed.

limitations: Suggested fingering remains the existing application guidance, not teacher-certified fingering.
Physical MIDI hardware was not available; overlapping MIDI ownership was simulated.
Performance samples are short rAF measurements on this Mac at the recorded viewport/device density, not a guarantee for all devices.
Native QA audio output was muted; this hand-art pass did not alter or re-audit the sampled instrument.
